rounds.proof_sketch: Thread 0 reaches i=4096 only in mutant. Inner guard idx<4096 evaluates false for all idx∈[4096,4103], so no computation occurs in the extra iteration. Both versions process exactly indices 0-4095.
rounds.survival_reason: The mutation changes the outer loop condition from `i < feature_dim` to `i <= feature_dim`. For the fixed configuration (feature_dim=4096, THREADS_PER_BLOCK=256, ELEMENTS_PER_THREAD=8), only thread 0 can reach i=4096. However, the inner loop guard `if (idx < feature_dim)` prevents any actual computation during this extra iteration since all idx values (4096 through 4103) fail the check. Both the original and mutant process exactly the same indices [0, 4095], making them functionally equivalent for this fixed shape.
rounds.kill_strategy: Unkillable under fixed shape contract. The inner guard makes the mutation semantically equivalent - no value combination can expose a difference.
rounds.recommendations: When testing relational operator mutations in nested loops, ensure test coverage includes configurations where inner guards do NOT mask the boundary change. This mutant survives because feature_dim aligns perfectly with the loop stride, causing the inner guard to neutralize the outer condition change.
